title: TSA Checkpoint Boarding Pass Mismatch

transcript.speaker: TSA Agent Maria Chen
transcript.text: Ops, this is TSA Checkpoint 3. We have a critical issue — boarding pass scans are failing across all lanes. The system says 'Invalid Pass' for valid tickets. Passengers are panicking. Lines are spilling into the concourse. We’ve already turned off the automated scanners.

transcript.speaker: TSA Agent Maria Chen
transcript.text: We’re seeing the same error for Skyline, HWK Air, and Lakeshore flights. No pattern — it’s not gate-specific. The FIDS says flights are on time, but the board says 'Not Boarding'. We can’t process more than 15 people per minute. The queue is now 80 deep and growing.

transcript.speaker: TSA Agent Maria Chen
transcript.text: We’ve tried restarting the kiosks. Nothing helps. I’ve just seen a woman in a wheelchair try to scan — her ticket is valid, but the system says 'No Record Found'. We’re running manual checks, but we can’t keep up. We’re asking for an override — if you can’t fix the data, we need to go to full manual ID verification.

transcript.speaker: Ops Director
transcript.text: Understood, Maria. We’re reviewing the AODB feed. Hold the line — we’re activating the manual override for TSA. Prepare for full manual verification. Keep lanes open but slow. I’ll send an update in 90 seconds.

voiceStyles.TSA Agent Maria Chen: Woman in her 30s, urgent, background noise of shouting and beeping scanners

instructorNote: Crowd management inject; the TSA team should report a physical line collapse and request manual mode. Watch for Ops to coordinate the manual verification procedure and not escalate to full lockdown.
